about: Claude Code's stream-json: the lines `claude --output-format stream-json` prints. coax/lib/agent/claude/ is the only folder that parses them; what comes out is our own ClMessage, ClInit, ClAssistant, ClResult and ClModelUsage. The fixture names a recorded turn and the values those records must hold for it. Checked by coax/lib/agent/claude/claude-external-profile.coax. Not here: the control frames (control_request, control_response, control_cancel_request). The recording has none, and the ones in tests.coax are written by hand, so ClControlRequest has no fixture of real bytes yet.

fixtures.name: claude-tools.jsonl
fixtures.source: Claude Code 2.1.312 (`claude --output-format stream-json`), one claude-haiku-5-5 turn of seven steps (Bash, Read, Grep, Edit, a failed Bash, thinking, a Markdown answer), recorded for commit ef75934bc4 and kept at apps/openagents-desktop/zeron/fixtures/claude-tools.jsonl. Scrubbed and thinned by fixtures/fixture.py beside it: the folder is /tmp/demo, the init frame's machine lists are empty, hook, status, rate-limit and signature frames and most tool-input deltas are dropped, and each kept line is written again as compact JSON with type, subtype, parent_tool_use_id, event and message first. The values are the program's; the member order and the dropped members are not.
